arStrings.szText: "The crown suits you. How do you feel?"
It doesn’t feel like mine yet. Soon I’ll be too busy to question it. A parade in Temis, then a tour across Skovos. And I need to choose a right hand.
Solemn and soft. A little overwhelmed by everything that needs done.
Listen to me, complaining already when I should be giving thanks. All of Skovos is in your debt. I am in your debt, friend.
Catches herself complaining, and brightens. Warm and self-aware - begins with a light, rueful chuckle at her own tone, then softens into genuine gratitude
I wish you many foes to slay on your next journey. Visit often. I’ll keep the wine ready.
